name: Kōka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kōka city emblem in green and orange: a green oval enclosing a white stylised figure and an orange four-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Kōka, a city in Shiga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2004.

features.role: Kōka city emblem — a green oval enclosing a white stylised figure and an orange four-pointed star
